rawContent: The #MeToo movement is a very popular and important movement. The Me Too movement is a movement against sexual abuse/assault, sexual harassment and rape culture. 🗣#SPCH145tweetsJ33
Social media has helped promote the #MeToo movement. Social media has also given the opportunity for survivors to share their stories through the #MeToo movement. #SPCH145tweetsJ33

One of the most important things the #MeToo movement does is let survivors of sexual assault/abuse know that they are not alone. They have people that want to help them and people that want to listen to their stories. #YouAreNotAlone #SPCH145tweetsJ33
The #MeToo movement has gotten so much publicity that it has reached other counties. In March of 2021, tens of thousands of people in Australia marched in support of the cause. #SPCH145tweetsJ33

The #MeToo movement states have started to introduce protection for employees. But self-employed employees still do not have enough legal protection from sexual harassment. So hopefully in the near future that will change. #SPCH145tweetsJ33
The #MeToo movement has helped so many people feel heard and that people care about their voice and their stories. The #MeToo movement is still helping people to this day. #SPCH145tweetsJ33
